paragraphs.text: Ambassador Blorpityblorpboop is an alien advisor guest and resident of Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun after the destruction of their homeworld Blorb-12 at the hands of Captain Rex Nebula .

Blorpityblorpboop is the de facto leader of the Blorbians, and thus titles themself Ambassador. As life-long guests of the park, Blorpityblorpboop and the other Blorbians have become unbeatable at all the park's arcade and carnival games.
Due to their history, Rex Nebula and the Ambassador have a friendly rivalry. Sometimes they even have dinner together.
